messages.author: ab7b24da45678eac
messages.subject: get sampler param names/values for sampler
parts:
In order to get the sampler parameters names/values into R, I added a couple of functions for
class stan::mcmc::adaptive_sampler/nuts/nuts_diag
https://code.google.com/p/stan/source/detail?r=1b516e80f2f9d83b52c3c6d53c9eb0e288630b3a#

For the adaptation information, for the time being, I just passed a stringstream to
write_adaptation_params and then get the information as character string.

Let me know if there is any problem.  Thanks. 

Jiqiang
